metaTitle: Mercedes 4-Cylinder Timing Chain Repair (M270/M274) | Mercedes Garage
metaDescription: Professional Mercedes 4-cylinder timing chain repair for M270/M274 engines. Full timing chain replacement, guides, tensioner, and camshaft adjusters at our Essex workshop. Get a quote.
lede: Precise timing chain replacement for M270 and M274 petrol engines - carried out in-vehicle using factory procedures, specialist locking tools, and Xentry calibration.

blocks.html: We replace the primary timing chain, tensioner, and guides on Mercedes M270 and M274 4-cylinder petrol engines. The work is performed with the engine in the vehicle, following Mercedes-Benz workshop procedures.

items: **Access & preparation** - battery disconnect, drain oil, remove ancillaries (fan, alternator, belts, radiator if needed), remove valve cover.
**Front cover removal** - crankshaft pulley and front timing cover are removed to expose the chain.
**Timing chain replacement** - camshafts are locked using factory fixtures, adjusters removed, old chain snaked out and new chain pulled through with assembly link.
**Reassembly & timing verification** - new tensioner installed, timing marks checked, cover sealed, ancillaries refitted, fresh oil added.
**Final testing** - manual rotation to verify timing, followed by Xentry diagnostic calibration and road test.

blocks.html: This is a high-precision job on an interference engine - timing accuracy is critical. We use the correct [M270](/mercedes-m270-engine) and [M274](/mercedes-m274-engine) engine-specific locking tools and follow the factory sequence to the letter.
We provide a tailored price after a no-obligation inspection. Contact us or use the registration lookup above for an instant estimate.
Images are staged in our workshop using real premises as reference. All replacement parts and tools are genuine Mercedes-specification.

sections.heading: Which Mercedes Models Use These Engines

The engine-family pages for [M270](/mercedes-m270-engine) and [M274](/mercedes-m274-engine) contain full application lists.

steps.title: Inspection & Assessment
steps.body: We carry out a full visual and mechanical check, confirming the chain, tensioner, and guides are the cause. We then provide a fixed-price quote.

steps.title: Vehicle Preparation
steps.body: Battery disconnected, oil drained, ancillaries removed, and the valve cover taken off to access the timing area.

steps.title: Front Cover Removal
steps.body: Crankshaft pulley and front timing cover are removed, giving full access to the chain, guides, and tensioner.

steps.title: Chain Replacement
steps.body: Camshafts locked with dedicated fixtures, adjusters removed, old chain snaked out and new chain installed with assembly link. Tensioner and guides replaced.

steps.title: Reassembly & Sealing
steps.body: Timing verified, cover resealed, all components refitted, fresh oil added to factory spec.

steps.title: Final Testing & Calibration
steps.body: Manual rotation to confirm timing, Xentry diagnostic adaptations, and a road test to ensure perfect operation.

items.q: Is the timing chain repair done with the engine in the car?
items.a: Yes - on M270/M274 engines, we perform the repair with the engine in the vehicle, following the Mercedes-Benz workshop manual. This avoids the extra labour of removing the engine.

items.q: What parts are replaced during the repair?
items.a: We replace the primary timing chain, chain guides, hydraulic tensioner, and all necessary gaskets and seals. Camshaft adjusters are inspected and replaced if required.

items.q: How long does the repair take?
items.a: Typically 12-16 hours of workshop time. We aim to complete the work within 2-3 working days, depending on parts availability.

items.q: Do you offer a warranty on the repair?
items.a: Yes - all our timing chain repairs come with a 12-month, unlimited-mileage warranty covering parts and labour.
Yes - we offer nationwide recovery from £70. Most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.
